heading: Reading
description: Books and papers from Ryan's twelve-month staff-engineering syllabus, with honest notes on where each one is wrong, where it changed how he works, and what he'd skip.
lede: What the syllabus is making me read, with honest notes: the parts I'd skip, where a book is wrong, and where it changed how I work. Updated as I finish things.
body: Annotated as I finish things, with honest notes including what to skip. Filling in from week one.
